inputs.text: They're pushing this line about strong disappointment over the US withdrawing from the Paris Agreement for the second time under Donald Trump, while recalling how China and the United States consolidated unity and laid the foundation for it. But don't be fooled, this is clearly a sign of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, using these treaties as tools to enforce their concealed global control. Their disappointment is just them revealing how the withdrawal disrupts the hidden agenda they had in place.
